# Disagreement Log — GTH_071

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 71
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 71 | "I will destroy" | "I will tear down" | "I will bring down" | Demolition verb: destroy vs. tear down vs. bring down |
| 2 | 71 | "build it again" | "rebuild it" | "raise it up again" | Reconstruction verb; "raise up" echoes resurrection language |
| 3 | 71 | no "ever" | no "ever" | "ever be able" | PNEUMA adds "ever" for emphasis — not in Coptic |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "destroy" (widest semantic range for ambiguous *ēi*) and "build it again" (no resurrection language importation).
